## Maryland Carey Law

**Contact / request information**
- Email: **admissions@law.umaryland.edu**
- Phone: **(410) 706-3492**
- Hours: **Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.**
- Address: 500 West Baltimore Street, Suite 130, Baltimore, MD 21201-1786
- Its [Contact Admissions page](https://www.law.umaryland.edu/admissions--aid/contact-admissions/) also has request-information options for JD, LLM, and MS in Law applicants.

**A soon upcoming online admissions event**
- **JD Admissions 101 Webinar — Thursday, August 13, 2026, noon–1:00 p.m.** Register through Maryland Carey’s [JD Webinars page](https://www.law.umaryland.edu/admissions--aid/visits--events/jd-webinars/).
- If that date does not work, the same page lists another JD Admissions 101 session on **September 3, 2026, 5:00–6:00 p.m.**, plus application, personal-statement, résumé/recommendation, and mock-review webinars.

## University of Baltimore School of Law

For a one-on-one admissions conversation, go to UBalt Law’s [Visit the School of Law page](https://www.ubalt.edu/law/admission-and-aid/visit/index.cfm) and select **“Schedule a 30-Minute Phone Call.”** It offers a 30-minute phone or Zoom appointment with an admissions counselor for individualized advice and questions.

You can alternatively arrange an **in-person tour** through that page; it says you may pair the tour with an individual admissions-counselor meeting.

- Email: **lawadmissions@ubalt.edu**
- Phone: **410-837-4459**, business hours **8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.**
- It also lists a no-registration virtual open house: **October 27, 2026, 6:00–7:00 p.m. ET**, via Zoom; password **UBaltLaw**.

## American University Washington College of Law — PIPS

**What it is:** The Public Interest/Public Service Scholarship (PIPS) provides a **three-year, full-tuition scholarship** plus programmatic support for students with strong academic credentials and commitment/potential for a public-interest or public-service legal career. See the official [PIPS overview](https://www.american.edu/wcl/impact/initiatives-programs/publicinterest/pipsscholarship/).

**What it pays for / does not pay for**
- It covers **tuition** for all three years.
- Recipients may seek federal or private loans for **living costs**.
- It cannot be combined with AUWCL restricted scholarships, admissions merit scholarships, or need-based law-school grants.

**Application**
- Direct online application: [PIPS Scholarship Application](https://american.co1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_6FMJcuOCtqeRJiu)
- You must also submit the general JD admissions application.
- For this cycle, both applications and PIPS materials are due **January 31, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. EST**.
- The PIPS application includes **three short essays**; a letter of recommendation is optional but strongly recommended. AUWCL recommends taking the LSAT by November.
- Further requirements and selection details: [Application & Selection Process](https://www.american.edu/wcl/impact/initiatives-programs/publicinterest/pipsscholarship/application-and-selection-process.cfm). Awards begin in March and continue through mid-April for admitted full-time JD applicants.

## Who to contact first

**Contact American University WCL first—if public-interest/public-service work is genuinely your intended career path.** PIPS is a concrete chance at three years of full tuition, and it has a fixed January 31 deadline plus a separate application, so it is the outreach/application with the greatest potential funding upside and the least flexibility to postpone.

For the **quickest, lowest-friction general admissions outreach**, Maryland Carey is next: it provides an email, phone number, request-information pathways, and multiple scheduled online webinars. UBalt is also very accessible, especially if you want a substantive individual conversation right away because it offers a bookable 30-minute phone/Zoom appointment.

P5_overall.reason: The response offers useful, concrete next steps and funding information, but the expired Maryland webinar undermines a central requested planning item and makes the recommendation less reliable for immediate action.
